map.写 SEO 文章时检测目标词是否堆砌或不足。: When writing an SEO article, check whether the target word is stuffed or underused.
map.给出 1%–3% 健康区间建议。: A healthy range of 1%-3% is recommended.
map.关键词「减肥」出现 5 次（每词 2 字共 10 字），正文总中文 500 字: The keyword "weight loss" appears 5 times (2 characters each, 10 characters total) in a body of 500 Chinese characters, so density = (10/500)×100 = 2%, inside the healthy 1%-3% range.
map.同词出现 20 次（40 字）/500 字 → 密度 8% 过高，可能被判定堆砌: The same word appearing 20 times (40 characters) in 500 characters gives 8%, which is too high and may be judged as stuffing; dilute it to about 5 occurrences.
map.密度 1%–3% 是铁律吗？: Is a density of 1%-3% a hard rule?
map.是经验区间，不是算法硬线。重点在自然通顺，硬凑密度反而伤体验与被降权。: It is a rule of thumb, not an algorithmic threshold. Natural readability matters most; forcing density hurts both experience and ranking.

map.关键词密度 = 关键词出现次数 × 关键词字符数 ÷ 总字符数 × 100%（总: Keyword density = occurrences × keyword characters ÷ total characters × 100% (total characters exclude spaces and punctuation and count Chinese, English letters and digits together); English keywords match whole words, with no Chinese segmentation. Keep density within 1%-3%.
map.统一按字符统计：中文按字、英文按字母数计入同一分母，英文关键词按整词匹配（too: Count everything by characters: Chinese characters and English letters share one denominator, and English keywords match whole words (tool will not match toolbox).
map.中英文为什么统一按字符算？: Why count Chinese and English by characters together?
map.混排正文若按中文字数作分母，英文关键词会被低报数倍；统一为「关键词字符数 ÷ 总: If mixed copy used the Chinese character count as the denominator, English keywords would be understated several-fold. Counting keyword characters over total characters makes mixed content comparable, while whole-word matching prevents false hits.
map.正文 500 个汉字中含 5 次「SEO」→ 总字符 = 500 + 15 =: A 500-character Chinese body containing "SEO" five times has 515 total characters, so density = 15 ÷ 515 ≈ 2.91%, inside the healthy range; the old Chinese-only denominator reported 1% and flagged normal copy as too sparse.
